answer: We formulate a mechanism integrating dynamic opportunity-cost bonds secured in a ferrous vault to deploy inescapable subgame-perfect punishment matrices against Sybil multiplication. By mandating staking collateral and deploying zero-knowledge verifiable delay constraints at an inlet, the protocol enforces strict slashing penalties that mathematically render the expected payoff of identity multiplication strictly negative. This architecture therefore forces rational adversaries into a robust strict Nash equilibrium, neutralizing multi-agent deviations.
